meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会把你的多个工作区/分支/PR 当作独立参会者,在共享聊天文件里组织只读站会,分轮发言并解决冲突,最后用大白话给出合并方案(基底、顺序、需你决定的事项)。它不会真的执行合并。
howto.when: 当你要求对比或合并多个工作区/分支/PR,或直接说“来个站会”时触发;如果候选少于两个,会告诉你并建议扩大范围。

say.text: 帮我把这几个分支拉进站会,最后给一份合并方案
say.note: Claude 会创建共享聊天并分轮讨论

say.text: 把最近 24 小时有改动的工作区都拉进站会对比
say.note: 按最近活跃时间筛选参会者

say.text: 用 PR #12 和当前分支做只读站会,不要真合并
say.note: 通过 gh 读取 PR,只产出方案

howto.what_en: Claude treats each of your worktrees, branches, or PRs as an attendee in a shared chat, runs a read-only standup in rounds, resolves conflicts, and ends with a plain consolidation plan (base, order, decisions for you). It does not merge.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to compare or consolidate multiple worktrees, branches, or PRs, or say 'standup'. If fewer than two candidates exist, it says so and offers to widen the scope.

say_en.text: Pull these branches into a standup and give me a merge plan.
say_en.note: Creates the shared chat and runs rounds.

say_en.text: Add all worktrees active in the last 24 hours to the standup.
Run a read-only standup with PR #12 and this branch; don't merge.
say_en.note: Reads the PR via gh and only produces a plan.
